'''Corridan Ordo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A member of [[Clan Ordo]], Corridan Ordo grew to become a respected ''alor'ad''—or [[Captain/Legends|captain]]—in the Mandalorian community, and became close friends with fellow Mandalorian [[Torian Cadera]]. Ordo, Cadera, and several other Mandalorian [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] were at one point tasked to destroy a weapons factory on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], a task which Ordo saw completed with the use of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed the [[Treaty of Coruscant|end]] of open conflict between the Republic and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Ordo took up [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] work for the Empire, and it was in that capacity that he was tasked to kill a Republic [[Senator/Legends|senator]] currently under [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] protection. Together with several of his Mandalorian comrades, Ordo succeeded, though he was struck in the head by a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blow during the course of the fighting, saved only by his [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|helmet]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I've got a mission, thought you might want in on it. Clan Ordo's been hired to kill a senator who's hiding out under major Jedi protection. It'll be a serious engagement. He's gone to ground in a heavily fortified area. Worth a lot of credits, too. If you're interested, meet us at the Baliss estate on Alderaan. Corridan out.|Corridan Ordo in a message to Torian Cadera|<ref name="TOR:BiA" />}}
A member of [[Clan Ordo]], Corridan Ordo was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who lived during the tumultuous period of [[Time/Legends|time]] known as the [[Great Galactic War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict between the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:WS" /> Having passed his ''[[verd'goten]]'' rite of passage at the age of thirteen and become an adult in Mandalorian culture,<ref name="The Mandalorians: People and Culture">{{InsiderCite|84|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> Ordo grew up to become a respected ''alor'ad''<ref name="TOR:WS" />—or "[[Captain/Legends|captain]]" in [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']]<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>—among the Mandalorian community, and he became close friends with his fellow Mandalorian, [[Torian Cadera]]. At some point during the war, Cadera joined Ordo and his clan as part of a Mandalorian team sent to destroy a weapons factory<ref name="TOR:WS" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. Ordo's [[Squad/Legends|unit]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were faced with [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] and [[Mine/Legends|mines]] on the way to the factory, which they had little trouble passing, but inside the factory they discovered [[Stealth field generator/Legends|cloaked]] resistance fighters hidden among the workers. Ordo evacuated as many of the innocent bystanders as he could before ordering his comrades behind cover and assaulting the resistance fighters with [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] them and destroying the factory.<ref name="TOR:WS" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] and the end of the hostilities between the Republic and Empire, Corridan Ordo contacted several old friends and arranged a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] trip to [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]],<ref name="TOR:HP">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Torian Cadera|Hunting Party}}</ref> the [[Species/Legends|beast]]-infested [[Tree/Legends|jungle]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="TEA" /> Many of the individuals he had served with previously were able to join Ordo on the trip, including Torian Cadera,<ref name="TOR:HP" /> whom Ordo came to owe fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] over the course of the trip.<ref name="TOR:WotW">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Torian Cadera|Ways of the Warrior}}</ref> While the group hunted mainly [[boma]]s and [[maalraas]], one Mandalorian by the name of [[Jagger]] managed to bring down a [[Zakkeg/Legends|zakkeg]] to the group's surprise and delight.<ref name="TOR:HP" />

Later, as tensions heightened between the Republic and Empire, Ordo and his clan were contracted to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] holed up in a heavily [[Fortress/Legends|fortified]] area under the protection of a significant [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] presence. Ordo invited Cadera to take part in the mission, leaving him a [[Holorecorder/Legends|message]] with instructions to meet Clan Ordo at the [[House Baliss|Baliss]] [[House Baliss (estate)|estate]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] if we were interested. Cadera, who was serving aboard the [[D5-Mantis Patrol Craft|vessel]] of the [[Hunter (individual)|latest]] [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt|Grand Champion]] of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], met up with Corridan and Clan Ordo and pursued their target. The Jedi protection detail proved a challenge to Ordo's people, causing casualties among the clan. Ordo was struck in the head by a glancing [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blow, however his [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] saved him from injury as it was made of [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]],<ref name="TOR:BiA" /> an incredibly resilient metal [[Ore/Legends|ore]] capable of withstanding a lightsaber, and found only on the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> and [[Concordia/Legends|one]] of its moons.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Corridan Ordo was a respected member of Clan Ordo,<ref name="TOR:WS" /> and maintained a close friendship with Torian Cadera, despite the dishonor that had been brought upon [[Clan Cadera|his clan]] by the actions of Cadera's [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Jicoln Cadera|Jicoln]]. He enjoyed hunting,<ref name="TOR:HP" /> and was known to be a bit of a showoff in the presence of an attractive female.<ref name="TOR:MI" />

==Equipment==
Ordo wore a set of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] forged from ''beskar'' iron ore, giving it the ability to withstand blows from a lightsaber.<ref name="TOR:BiA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corridan Ordo first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="TOR:BiA" />
